description: Returns a replacement link for the homeowner to open and claim their draft. The old link stops working. Rate limited; unknown or expired statusHandle values receive the same generic NOT_FOUND answer. Only the homeowner sends the job to contractors inside InstaBids; this tool cannot send it.

statusHandle.description: The statusHandle returned by start_job (43 characters). Expires seven days after creation.

name: reissue_claim_link
title: Replace a draft claim link
